text:
anna (PM): FYI — spotted a competitor pushing a lightweight self-hosted inference product + a very low-cost public API. they shipped docs + a comparison matrix this morning. worried about noise in inbound.
chao (Eng): link? curious how they handle routing/fallbacks.
ravi (Research): https://example.com/edgeserve/compare (excerpt). they emphasize tiny deploy bundle and a fixed-price per-instance plan. early benchmarks show good latency for short sequences.
sam (AE): getting questions today from two existing pilots asking for an on-prem affordable option. price is the ask.
maria (Dir, Product): we should decide fast: parity (match their offering) vs double-down on differentiators (routing, SLOs, cost controls). proposal: 1) short tactical parity: minimal self-hosted SKU + clear enterprise add-ons, 2) medium: bundle private with per-route SLOs and rollout tools, 3) long: Optimize runtime for small-instance economics. thoughts?
jen (Design): packaging matters — if we go parity-low-cost we need a 1-click install and simple UX for resource limits. otherwise signal will be confusing.
chao (Eng): rough feasibility: we can create a slim distro in ~4w (2w spike + 2w build), will need to trim optional features (no console, no heavy telemetry) for the MVP.
anna (PM): @chao can we get the 2w spike estimate as t-shirt sizes? we need to brief sales by EOD Wed.
chao (Eng): spike sizes: S=dependency audit + slim build (3 dev-days), M=packaging + basic install script (8 dev-days), L=secure-ops + KMS integration (20 dev-days).
maria (Dir, Product): launch criteria suggestion (must meet to ship parity SKU):
```
- install completes offline (no external calls)
- basic inference throughput within 1.5x hosted median for <512 tokens
- minimal audit events emitted to local file/KV
- documented enterprise upsell path (Dedicated/Private)
```
anna (PM): + commercial guardrails: we price parity SKU low but require enterprise contact to unlock SLA/region support. keeps us from chasing every low-touch lead.
sam (AE): agreement — sales needs a short battlecard: target ICP for parity SKU, upsell triggers, and competitive messaging. I can draft by Thu.
ravi (Research): signal-wise: our telemetry shows 18% of requests in hosted are <128 tokens and very latency-sensitive — low-cost small-instance option could cannibalize those but also reduce hosted load.
jen (Design): recommend a simple launch banner in console: "Lightweight self-hosted (preview) — for single-tenant, low-cost use" with clear upsell CTA.
chao (Eng): caveat: removing console + analytics will complicate support. propose we add a minimal telemetry opt-in and a simple log upload tool for debugging. (~5 dev-days)
maria (Dir, Product): decision path: do we greenlight spike + battlecard + 2w design/eng sync? If yes, we aim for a parity preview in 6w. If no, we focus on amplifying differentiators (per-route SLOs, routing policies) and push a comms play.
anna (PM): vote: I vote spike+preview. gives sales something to sell and lets us learn price elasticity.
chao (Eng): vote: spike.
jen (Design): vote: spike for UX learnings.
sam (AE): vote: spike. need to manage inbound comms.
ravi (Research): vote: spike, but allocate an experiment goal to measure migration from hosted -> parity SKU.
maria (Dir, Product): ok spike approved. action items: @chao - start 2w spike, @jen - UX flows for 1-click, @sam - battlecard draft, @ravi - metric plan, @anna - update exec brief. aim to sync next Tue.
deploy-bot: new-cycle: weekly-roadmap-sync scheduled for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC.
anna (PM): thanks. I'll post a short note for support and ops to expect preview inbound leads. :thumbsup:
